about: Mobile apps published by ShaadDev Studio (developer "shaad dev studio" on Google Play, "Rizwan Rashid" on the App Store). Every listed app was live in its store on the date in "checked". Features, pricing and privacy facts are taken from each app's own store listing and the developer's Play Data safety / App Store privacy declarations.

categories.title: Volume limiter and screen dimmer apps

apps.name: AI Voice Clone & Text-to-Speech Studio
apps.description: Clone your voice from a short recording and turn text into natural speech on Android and iPhone.
apps.pricing: Free to download with in-app purchases. On iPhone a Premium subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly) unlocks unlimited generations, up to 10,000 characters per generation and the full voice catalog.

apps.name: Mimicly: AI Voice Changer & Voice Clone
apps.description: Android app to clone your own voice, turn scripts into speech and change your voice for short videos.
apps.pricing: Free to download; contains ads and in-app purchases.

apps.name: VoiceTwin AI: Voice Cloning
apps.description: iPhone app for text to speech with 300+ voices in several languages and cloning your own voice.
apps.pricing: Start free; a Premium subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly) unlocks unlimited generations, longer scripts and the full voice library.

apps.name: PixelForge - Text to Image AI
apps.description: iPhone text-to-image AI app that makes up to 8 variations of an idea in one tap.
apps.pricing: Free to start; no subscription is required to generate. Optional in-app purchases are offered.

apps.name: PhotoGem: AI Pix Video Prompts
apps.description: Android gallery of 500+ ready-to-copy prompts for AI photos and AI videos.
apps.pricing: Free to download; contains ads and in-app purchases.

apps.name: PromptGenius: AI Prompts
apps.description: Prompt library and prompt builder for chat and image AI models, for work topics like SEO, marketing and coding.
apps.pricing: Free to download with in-app purchases; the Android app contains ads.

apps.name: PixPrompter: AI Prompt Library
apps.description: iPhone library of 1,000+ copy-ready prompts for AI profile pictures, logos and stickers.
apps.pricing: Free to download; optional in-app purchases.

apps.name: PromptCraft: AI Photo Editing
apps.description: iPhone collection of copy-paste prompts for AI photo editing styles like cinematic, retro and studio portraits.
apps.pricing: Free to download; optional Premium Access in-app purchase.

apps.name: CardVault: Sports Card Scanner
apps.description: Scan a sports card with your phone camera to identify it and see its value from recent sold prices.
apps.pricing: Free to download; scanning is free to try; valuations and the portfolio tracker are part of a paid in-app upgrade.

apps.name: Stamp ID: Scanner & Value
apps.description: iPhone stamp identifier: scan a postage stamp to learn its origin, year and estimated value.
apps.pricing: Free to download; Premium subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly) or a lifetime purchase in the app.

apps.name: Volume Lock: Parental Control
apps.description: Set a maximum volume on your child's phone or tablet and protect it with a PIN.
apps.pricing: Free to download. Android: contains ads and in-app purchases. iPhone: optional Premium subscription or Pro purchase.

apps.name: Volume Locker
apps.description: Android app that locks volume and brightness levels so they do not change by accident, with PIN and auto silent.
apps.pricing: Free to download; contains ads and in-app purchases (Pro adds schedules and auto silent).

apps.name: Dimmer: Night Screen OLED Lens
apps.description: Dim your Android screen below the lowest system brightness for reading in the dark.
apps.pricing: Free to download; contains ads and in-app purchases (Pro).

apps.name: FlashPad – Quick Notes
apps.description: Offline Android quick notes that delete themselves after a time you choose and detect phone numbers, links and addresses.
apps.pricing: Free to download; in-app purchase for Pro.

apps.name: IncomeMap: Income & Expenses
apps.description: iPhone expense tracker and budget planner with loan tracking and PDF receipts.
apps.pricing: Free to download; one-time Lifetime Access in-app purchase.

apps.name: BDVibes: Birthday Reminders
apps.description: Birthday and anniversary reminder app with countdowns and age tracking.
apps.pricing: Free to download with an in-app purchase.

apps.name: Footprint: Username Checker
apps.description: Check your own username on 45 sites to find old accounts and see your digital footprint.
apps.pricing: Free to download with banner ads; open results by watching one optional short ad or with Pro (monthly or yearly subscription; yearly has a 7-day free trial for new subscribers). If no ad loads, results open anyway.

apps.name: Fyzik: Body Scan & AI Workout Planner
apps.description: Take an AI body scan with your phone camera and get a gym or home workout plan that updates with each scan.
apps.pricing: Free to download; contains ads and in-app purchases.

apps.name: Riz Word: Calm Letter Puzzle
apps.description: Relaxing word puzzle: swipe a ring of letters to find hidden words, with no timer.
apps.pricing: Free to download; banner and occasional full-screen ads between puzzles; optional rewarded videos; one-time purchases (remove ads, bundles, coins) and an optional weekly Riz Pass subscription.

apps.name: CineLUT – Photo & Video LUTs
apps.description: Offline Android app with 500 LUT color presets for photos and videos, with .cube export.
apps.pricing: Free to download with ads; 350 LUTs free; a single one-time Pro purchase unlocks all 500 (no subscription).

apps.name: RYK Hub: Rahim Yar Khan App
apps.description: City app for Rahim Yar Khan, Pakistan: electric bus routes and schedules, local services and business listings.
apps.pricing: Free to download; contains ads.
